title: The Giver
author: Lois Lowry
summary: In a seemingly perfect community where everything is controlled, twelve-year-old Jonas is chosen to carry the society's memories of the past from an old man, and begins to see what has been given up.
readIf: you want a short, thought-provoking dystopia that works well for younger or newer readers.
skipIf: you want detailed worldbuilding or an action-heavy ending; the story is quiet and ambiguous.

pairings.reason: Another short dystopia that questions what society gives up for comfort and safety.
A quiet, devastating novel about a strange, closed society and the lives inside it.
A faster, more violent young adult dystopia with similar questions about control.
